title: Let's answer your questions (because I'm snowed in) - money, bullying, moving on from youtube
en: Hello everyone. I hope you're having a wonderful holiday season. We had plummeting temperatures this week, overg -30 at one point, and consequently, I was pretty cooped up indoors and unable to enjoy nature in the same way I usually do. I compromised on this week's video in order to bring you a simple little Q&A. I hope you enjoy it and hopefully soon I will be out in nature once again and be able to share its treasures with you.
Hello. I hope the holiday season is

treating you well. I was planning on uploading this video a while ago, but I got caught up in holiday celebrations. It got extremely cold and we were having flickering power and power outages. And I decided to sit down and make something a little cozier and simpler just for this week. And if more chatty videos are not your cup of tea, no worries at all. I will see you next week with my more usual content. I have been working on some videos that really mean a lot to me. So, I'm very excited to share them with you. I have been meaning to do a Q&A video for such a long time. There are a lot of new fairy friends and magical creatures in this little corner of the world. And so I wanted to say hello and introduce myself but also

answer some questions that have been following this channel around for a couple years now. I will recap a couple basic things though. One is that my name is Paola and I live in a rural valley in Washington state in the US. I live here with my husband Luke. He is a land surveyor in this local area as well as my pets Iger and Mavi. I did lose a dear sweet bunny this year. His name was Mr. Darcy and he was very close to my heart and it's been difficult not having him. So, I do hope to have maybe a bunny again in the future, hopefully next year. So, one of the first questions I had is what do you do for work? And the answer to that is that I do a variety of things. I have been working on the

weekends at my little local bookstore, but that is definitely the smallest part of what I do. I run an Etsy shop. That is definitely my main job and something I'm incredibly grateful for to be able to do. I make mostly kind of children's inspired art and fairy art as well as just nature art in general. And of course, I make videos here on YouTube and that is definitely a very important part of the work I do. I don't do sponsored content, so definitely my Etsy shop is kind of my main job and my main way that I'm able to make a living. I like to do a variety of jobs. Many people in this little valley actually do that. They diversify just to make things work. And so, it's been always interesting to evolve. I am uncertain that I will be able to continue working

at my little bookshop because I have time commitments in other places in my life currently. So, I may not be working there for the new year, but I hope to work there again in the future because I really, really enjoy it. Another question was, "What is your favorite meal?" And I will answer that. I don't necessarily have a favorite meal, but I have many, many favorite desserts. I love cream brulee. I love ice cream. I love sweet drinks. I am just a sweet tooth. Such a sweet tooth. Favorite meals? I would say probably stir fries and sushi. I'm not able to get a lot of those foods here locally because we're very limited in our restaurants. I also love a good pasta dish. Another question was, "What are your favorite children's

books?" I have so many, so I can't possibly choose. However, some very favorites that come to mind are Journey, Maybe, and the Bramblely Hedge books are really adorable as well, as well as, of course, the Peter Rabbit books. Another question was, "What are your goals for the new year?" I haven't quite decided what I want to do for the new year quite yet. However, I do really want to consistently keep a journal. I have always wanted to be able to do that, and I've never been very successful. And so, I'm going to attempt to do that next year. And I think my goal every year pretty much is to continue discovering how to create a very healthy work life balance. I am someone who tends to overdo it on work, and so I'm always

trying to reel myself back a little bit. How did you find your property was another question. I was very very very lucky because the properties in this area as well as so many places in the states are so extremely expensive right now and it is very difficult to be able to afford it. My husband and I looked out as he was born and raised in this little valley and his parents moved here uh way before it got this expensive and so they had a property right next to them that had a barn on it that they renovated. They were able to sell it to us at a price that we could afford and to this day we're just so incredibly grateful that we had that opportunity and that we had family nearby. Another question was, I see that you worked in customer service. How have the holidays

been? That is a very considerate question. A lot of customer service workers are working overtime and working so hard during the holiday season. It can be absolutely exhausting. So, if you have the opportunity to give some festive well-wishes to a customer service worker, I know that they will appreciate it. While it did get quite busy at my little bookstore, it was at no point overwhelming, which was really nice cuz I've worked at customer service jobs where there have been people lined up for, you know, yards. And so, that was very stressful. So, thankfully, this was a really lovely Christmas for me, despite it, of course, being a busy one. You know, I was working Christmas Eve, so I did enjoy it. It's really lovely to spend time with my co-workers, but it is

not always easy. Do you have any advice for people who also want to be teachers or child care workers? I used to be a childare worker. It is what I moved over to this valley to do. I was a teacher at a little independent school. I really loved it. It was just wonderful. But I will say, you know, when you are working with well over a dozen children, sometimes up to 16 or more, not only physically are you moving up and down and doing things all day long, it can be difficult to take breaks because there are children in your care and of course they come first and their safety comes first. Children also very much respond to how you are doing emotionally. And so it's really important to regulate your emotions and you know really help create

a good atmosphere in the classroom even if you're having a difficult day or something's happening in your personal life. So it is um definitely I have so much respect for childare workers and teachers. It's just such a amazing job. The people that do it are incredible and they definitely should be appreciated more. It is such incredible work and such vital work for our future. How did you learn about foraging and wild foods? The answer to that is kind of simple. I I I just kind of learned as I went. I definitely can look back at some very old videos and see things that kind of I did incorrectly. I definitely was learning about wildcrafting and foraging

as I was making these videos. And of course, I knew I was going to make mistakes. However, a combination of things really helped me. There were a couple books that were written by a local author here that really helped me get a start and just jumping in and, you know, asking questions and being curious, finding people that also are passionate about it. And it takes a lot of learning and it takes a long time before you can gain confidence in plant identification and how to use them. But you do get there eventually if you have the perseverance. Another question was that are you going to quit YouTube soon? Um the answer is no. I do hope to continue making videos for quite a while longer. However, I think that as with many of these sorts of careers, there's going to be an end point. So, I'm just

doing my best to enjoy every week and communicate with all of you and really appreciate all the kind words and feedback, you know, while we have this right now. I do not know. I can't tell. I don't know what the future's going to hold. This was an interesting question that I got and it was, "I love reading, but I have a hard time concentrating due to being distracted by technology. Do you have any advice?" I like that question because I think it is something that a lot of us deal with. I know that there have been times in my life when I've had a hard time concentrating on reading, especially in school when I was just so busy. I think something that helped me was really just to create a very designated time even if it was just 10 minutes to half an hour, maybe an hour. I would really recommend that you

know really try a variety of different books and see what you enjoy. There is comedy, there is drama, there's mystery, there's more simpler style books, more complicated, and really remember that I think it's important not to feel obligation to continue reading a book if it's just not speaking to you. I also love kind of creating a ritual where I light a candle. I might put on some music unless it bothers you. And I love putting on some ambient music. There's some really awesome things on YouTube. You can look up ambient rooms or ambient playlist for any type of atmosphere that matches the book you're reading. Reading is not a necessarily superior hobby to any other hobby. You know, if I want to spend my evening painting instead of

reading, that is just as valid. I think sometimes we see reading as a very kind of um fruitful activity and a very important thing for us to do, but you know there's a lot of equally important sorts of hobbies that we could spend our time doing as well. So never connect not reading as failing in some shape or form. This question also connects a bit to another one which is how do you de-stress? And it is kind of usually a similar thing. I have more than ever recently put it upon myself to really prioritize taking a little bit of time to write a little bit in a journal, to listen to some calming music and meditate or spend time kind of in uh a more spiritual space. That time spent in relaxation is very important for the

success of the rest of your day. We can be productive and arguably we might be able to be even more productive or at least more happy to be productive if we do prioritize a little bit of that time for the sake of our psychological and physical health as well. Do you have any favorite music? I have a kind of variety of music I like to listen to. However, I most often gravitate towards more ambient music and music that helps me concentrate on whatever I'm doing. I do a lot of work. I spend a lot of time painting as well as working on my computer. I really love some of the albums of Priscilla an as well as Katie Malua. They have very soft, very beautiful voices that always calm me down. I also like, of course,

soundtracks to amazing movies. I love course a lot of Studio Geekly, a lot of Lord of the Rings, all types of things. I love this question. What is your favorite tea? I really love just any type of tea that is floral. Jasmine tea. I think I had some sort of lotus flower tea recently that was delicious. I just I love floral teas. Another question is do you work out? I um I do not I have I am however active. I don't know what would constitute necessarily working out or not working out but um I do love to go on nature walks. I go on them almost every day. In the winter, I'm a little more yeah, just a lovely little hike or

a walk. Um, I'm not really a workout sort of person in general. So, that's just kind of the way that I stay active and mobile and just I love doing work that keeps me moving. So, I guess I just move throughout the day. How are you not scared of wild animals living out in the forest? I see this question fairly often. I assume it comes from people who have not lived out in rural areas. Um, through my experience and through the experience of most people who I talk to, um, you know, wild animals really just want to be left alone and they want to be respected and it is, uh, very rare, extremely rare for an animal to be intentionally aggressive towards you in any way. For example, we

have bears are a pretty common sighting around here. And pretty much all they want to do is just eat the berries out of your tree and take a nap on the lawn. You know, you definitely want to avoid them and give them their space, but they're not trying to be aggressive. The amount of incidences are so incredibly low. For example, compare the amount of people that are attacked by a wild animal to the amount of people who are attacked by other humans. It is a very telling comparison. Do you prefer the forest or your previous cottage on the prairie? I would say I love both for different reasons. The prairie was really wonderful. If you walked through for enough time, you could see little quail nests and all

sorts of little signs of life and I really love that. However, here in the forest, it is so beautiful and it's much cooler in the summer as well. I love both. But of course, right now, I'm really appreciating being surrounded by trees. It just feels like a big hug. What are five things we didn't know about you? I like this question. It's so random. I once won a local version of the reading rainbow competition. I think it was only um aired in my state. I don't know. I assume it was aired in my state or maybe only in my local area, but I won one of the reading rainbow competitions when I was really little and I got to read my book on KCTS. So, somewhere in some archives, there's a video of me reading my book that I wrote

and illustrated, and it um I think was called Tail Tales, and it was about this island called the island of Bingo where cats and dogs live together, and it was kind of a legend. So, it was a very strange story. If I ever find that book, I'm sure I have it somewhere here. I will read it to you. I used to also compete a little bit in rabbit shows when I was a kid. There was a kid version of rabbit showing where you would just bring your pet rabbit and you would train your little rabbit to sit very properly and you would answer questions about your rabbit to a judge. And I used to do that. It was with a 4 program which is pretty popular here in the states and it was uh really fun. But it led me to knowing a very strangely

large amount of information about rabbits. My best friend growing up was over 60 years old and she was my art teacher and we would spend sometimes the weekends together quilting and um yeah just baking and painting and having fun and um I have so many lovely memories of her. I can speak English, Spanish and heringa. If you know what heringa is, you probably are Hispanic. Um the fifth thing, um I absolutely love sparkling water. If it could come out of the faucet, I would be so happy. How did you know you wanted to marry your husband? I definitely knew my husband was someone that I wanted in my life when I realized how safe I felt around him and how I felt so seen and so

respected. I just really appreciated that and I wanted to get that in return because I appreciated it so much. And I've known what it's like to be in relationships where I felt unsafe and not respected whatsoever. And I've just always loved that about him. He's also a very caring and very authentic person and very kind of generous with his emotions and his time. Another question was, "What is your favorite dress and do you have any advice for creating a wardrobe you love?" I don't have a favorite dress. I'll put in a clips of a couple of my favorites just because they're very wellm made and they fit me um in a way that is comfortable. I love going to thrift shops. I also love um doing kind

of assorted thrift shopping online. Thread Up is a website that I have used in the past to find some discounted pieces. However, I would say that it is so important to be comfortable in your clothing because if you are adjusting your clothing or just very fixated on something that's uncomfortable, it really kind of um you know puts your energy more inward and more self-conscious. And I think it's so important to just feel comfortable in your own skin and clothes that help you feel that way, you know, and it'll be so much easier to be confident. I had one last question and that was how do I deal with uh cyber bullying or you know negative people in general in my real life or online and that is a tricky one

to answer because I think it depends on you know the person and your personality and what you're able to handle and what you're able to let go of. It has not always been easy for me to deal with bullies in person or online, but it does really help me to remember that that saying, what is it? Hurt people hurt people, I think is how that saying goes, that it helps to remember that people's negative actions towards you often say a lot more about them than they do about you. And I think it's very important especially when it comes to bullying online to be able to unplug when necessary to be able to step away from that sphere and you know really ground yourself. Working online you get your

fair share of bullying and I I I do find that it has really deeply helped me to just remember that you know happy people don't want to go and say hateful words towards other people. you know, those people are really struggling and they're going through something and it really isn't about you at the end of the day. And while it's easier said than done, that does mean that you should do your best to try to not let those words, you know, define you. They can hurt and that's totally normal to have that feeling of hurt. I have come to accept that it is totally okay to feel pain in your heart when people are very unkind to you. But I've also, you know, really tried to use it to inspire me to just,

you know, do something extra that day to be kind to someone else in a way almost like balancing out those very unkind words with kind words. And remembering that no matter what you do, there will be people who will not like what you're doing. No matter who you are, there will be people who don't like who you are for one reason or another. Sometimes there will be people who don't even give you the opportunity to offer who you are or what you do and they will just make a judgment right off the bat. Perhaps it's easier to put yourself out there and try new things and get out of your comfort zone if you know ahead of time that that sort of thing will always happen and no matter what you do, you know, there

will, you know, be people who don't understand. So, you really need to try to put your best foot forward and focus on the positive. To not suppress those feelings of pain, to acknowledge them and understand that that's normal to feel hurt when people say unkind things, but to continue having courage, you know, and trying to move forward despite it. Yes, take it from someone who has been making videos for quite a while. You're never going to be able to please everyone. There will always be people as well that misunderstand your intentions or your words and you just can't prevent it. And that is, I think, a lifetime journey of being able to continue letting things go. But there's no shame in feeling that

hurt and, you know, feeling that way. That is totally okay. I've always, you know, I've always had trouble with that statement of just grow a thick skin because I think for some people, you know, we're always going to be in touch with our emotions and we're always going to have moments where we feel hurt. And I think it's more about how we respond to those feelings and whether or not we let them define our view of other people or define the view of ourselves that, you know, is so much more important. there's so much positivity, but as well like useful feedback and constructive criticism that you can take to heart a lot more. And I think those people um deserve a lot more of your time and energy, of course, right? And you deserve a lot more of your time and

energy. And the more time and focus you put on these negative words, the more that's taking away from you and your ability to enjoy your present. So, I think that's all I can say, but it's a complicated one. I still struggle with it. I still don't feel like I have the answers there, but I am with you and I do feel for you and I understand. So, yes, I think those were all the questions that I had written down. I hope that this felt like a cozy little tea party, and I hope to see you very soon in one of my more usual types of videos. I've been very excited to showcase the winter wonderland over here. It has been incredible. As you can see, I have some St. John's

wart and eucalyptus that I've been trying out to try to make into some craft projects. So, there are a lot of fun little ideas on the horizon. Thank you so much for joining me. I hope you have a wonderful new year. Do let me know if you have any resolutions or goals. Sending you all the well wishes. Take care of yourselves and I will see you very soon. Goodbye.
zh: 大家好。我希望您度过了一个愉快的假期。这周气温骤降，一度超过-30度，因此，我被关在室内，无法像平时那样享受大自然。我对本周的视频做出了妥协，以便为您带来一个简单的小问答。我希望你喜欢它，并希望很快我就能再次来到大自然中，并能够与你分享它的宝藏。
你好。我希望假期是
对你很好。我不久前就打算上传这个视频，但我正忙着庆祝节日。天气变得非常冷，我们的电源闪烁并且停电。我决定坐下来，为这周做一些更舒适、更简单的事情。如果您不喜欢更多聊天视频，也不必担心。下周我会以更平常的内容与您见面。我一直在制作一些对我来说意义重大的视频。所以，我很高兴与大家分享它们。我想做一个问答视频很久了。在这个世界的小角落里有很多新的仙女朋友和神奇生物。所以我想打个招呼并介绍自己，但也

回答一些多年来一直关注此频道的问题。不过，我将回顾一些基本的事情。一是我叫保拉，住在美国华盛顿州的一个乡村山谷里。我和我的丈夫卢克住在这里。他是当地的一名土地测量员，还有我的宠物艾格和马维。今年我确实失去了一只可爱的小兔子。他的名字叫达西先生，我对他很亲近，没有他在身边我很难受。所以，我确实希望将来能再次拥有一只兔子，希望是明年。所以，我的第一个问题是你做什么工作？答案是我做了各种各样的事情。我一直在致力于

周末在我当地的小书店，但这绝对是我所做的最小的一部分。我经营一家 Etsy 商店。这绝对是我的主要工作，也是我非常感激能够做的事情。我主要创作儿童艺术和童话艺术以及一般的自然艺术。当然，我在 YouTube 上制作视频，这绝对是我工作中非常重要的一部分。我不做赞助内容，所以我的 Etsy 商店肯定是我的主要工作，也是我谋生的主要方式。我喜欢做各种各样的工作。这个小山谷里的很多人实际上都是这样做的。他们多元化只是为了让事情顺利进行。因此，进化总是很有趣的。我不确定我是否能够继续工作

在我的小书店，因为我目前在生活中的其他地方有时间承诺。所以，新年我可能不会在那里工作，但我希望将来能再次在那里工作，因为我真的非常喜欢它。另一个问题是，“你最喜欢吃什么？”我会回答这个问题。我不一定有最喜欢的饭菜，但我有很多很多最喜欢的甜点。我喜欢奶油布丁。我喜欢冰淇淋。我喜欢甜饮料。我只是一个爱吃甜食的人。真是爱吃甜食啊。最喜欢的饭菜？我想说可能是炒菜和寿司。我在当地买不到很多这样的食物，因为我们的餐厅非常有限。我也喜欢美味的面食。另一个问题是，“你最喜欢孩子们的什么？
书？”我有很多，所以我不可能选择。不过，我最喜欢的是《旅程》，《也许》，《荆棘树篱》的书也很可爱，当然，还有《彼得兔》的书。另一个问题是，“你新年的目标是什么？”我还没有完全决定新年要做什么。但是，我真的很想坚持写日记。我一直希望能够做到这一点，我从来没有取得过很大的成功，所以，我想明年我的目标几乎是继续探索如何创造一个非常健康的工作生活平衡，所以我总是在工作中过度。

试图把自己拉回来一点。你如何找到你的财产是另一个问题。我非常非常非常幸运，因为这个地区以及美国很多地方的房产现在都非常昂贵，很难负担得起。我和我丈夫看着他在这个小山谷出生和长大，他的父母在房价变得这么贵之前就搬到了这里，所以他们在旁边有一处房产，上面有一个谷仓，他们翻新了。他们能够以我们能承受的价格把它卖给我们，直到今天，我们非常感激我们有这个机会，而且我们的家人就在附近。另一个问题是，我看到你从事客户服务工作。假期过得怎么样

到过？这是一个非常深思熟虑的问题。假期期间很多客服人员都加班加点，辛苦工作。这可能绝对让人筋疲力尽。所以，如果你有机会向客服人员表达一些节日祝福，我知道他们会很感激的。虽然我的小书店确实很忙，但一点也不让人不知所措，这真的很好，因为我从事过客户服务工作，那里有人排队，你知道，码。所以，这是非常有压力的。所以，值得庆幸的是，这对我来说是一个非常可爱的圣诞节，尽管它当然是一个忙碌的圣诞节。你知道，我在平安夜工作，所以我确实很享受。与同事共度时光真的很愉快，但

并不总是那么容易。您对那些也想成为教师或儿童保育员的人有什么建议吗？我曾经是一名儿童工作者。这就是我搬到这个山谷要做的事。我是一所小型私立学校的老师。我真的很喜欢它。真是太棒了。但我要说的是，你知道，当你和十几个孩子一起工作时，有时多达 16 个或更多，你不仅在身体上整天上下移动和做事，而且很难休息，因为你要照顾孩子，当然他们是第一位的，他们的安全也是第一位的。孩子们也会对你的情绪表现做出很大的反应。所以调节你的情绪非常重要，你知道这确实有助于创造
即使您度过了困难的一天或个人生活中发生了一些事情，课堂上也能保持良好的氛围。所以，我绝对非常尊重儿童工作者和老师。这真是一项了不起的工作。做到这一点的人是令人难以置信的，他们绝对应该受到更多的赞赏。这是一项令人难以置信的工作，也是对我们的未来至关重要的工作。您是如何了解觅食和野生食物的？答案很简单。我我只是边走边学。我绝对可以回顾一些非常旧的视频并看到我做错的事情。我确实在学习野性制作和觅食
